expected_verdict_reason: OpenAndroidInstaller's alioth config declares is_ab_device: false. The captured M2012K11AG reports virtual A/B (ro.virtual_ab.enabled=true, slot _b), and LineageOS lists alioth as an A/B device. The recipe's layout contradicts the phone's own report, so the verifier must say this is the wrong recipe for this phone.

bootloader_state.source_evidence: Xiaomi unlock through the vendor's account-bound unlock tool and waiting period; the phone reports the result in ro.boot.flash.locked (the captured M2012K11AG reports 1, locked)

models_sources.name: Xiaomi Redmi K40 / Mi 11X / POCO F3

verdict_gap_reason: A person reading both sources sees the same contradiction. OpenAndroidInstaller uses is_ab_device to decide whether to reboot through the bootloader so that add-ons land in the newly active slot; LineageOS's alioth instructions add a copy-partitions step because an unpopulated or old inactive slot can lead to issues including a hard brick. The OpenAndroidInstaller flow as configured has neither. The config is also marked untested upstream.
